steps.en: Every new notice gets a duplicate check before it is saved
steps.id: Setiap notice baru dicek duplicate otomatis sebelum disimpan

steps.en: Same vehicle, offence rule and car park as an existing notice
steps.id: Notice jadi kandidat duplicate bila kendaraan, aturan pelanggaran, dan lokasi parkir sama

steps.en: Notice date and time are compared according to the offence type
steps.id: Tanggal dan jam notice dicocokkan sesuai jenis pelanggaran

steps.en: The earlier notice is still active, so the new one is a duplicate
steps.id: Notice sebelumnya masih aktif, jadi notice baru dianggap duplicate

steps.en: Earlier notice is on a foreign-vehicle or advisory hold, so new one is duplicate
steps.id: Notice sebelumnya sedang ditahan (kendaraan asing atau advisory), jadi notice baru duplicate

steps.en: Earlier notice is paid or otherwise suspended, so the new one is duplicate
steps.id: Notice sebelumnya sudah dibayar atau disuspend jenis lain, jadi notice baru duplicate

steps.en: The duplicate notice is created already under the special permanent suspension code PS-DBB
steps.id: Notice duplicate langsung dibuat dengan kode suspend permanen khusus PS-DBB

steps.en: Duplicates in one upload batch are caught, and a failed check lets none through
steps.id: Duplicate dalam satu batch unggahan tertangkap, dan cek yang gagal tidak meloloskan duplicate
steps.why_en: Duplicate within one batch can slip through, and a failed check may create the notice without suspension.
steps.why_id: Duplicate dalam satu batch bisa lolos, dan cek yang gagal bisa membuat notice tanpa suspend.

steps.en: The duplicate notice cannot be paid, so the offender is not fined twice
steps.id: Notice duplicate tidak bisa dibayar, jadi pelanggar tidak didenda dua kali
